Usage:  <samples>

Report percentiles from a set of samples

Options:
  samples          Samples to summarize. ([]float64)
  --scale          Multiply each sample by this scale factor before reporting. (float32, default: 1)
  --percentiles    Percentiles to report. ([]float64, default: 50,95,99)

Subcommands:
  version          Show version information.
